strongestMinorityReport: A minority held that the impossible mean alone warrants reject-and-resubmit until the raw data are seen, and this position did not weaken under exchange.

surfacedFindings.claim: Support for the practical-significance framing fell sharply once reviewers weighed the impossible mean, marking it a fragile basis for the effect claim.
surfacedFindings.failureScenario: A practical claim resting on a contested statistic collapses if the statistic is corrected downward.
surfacedFindings.leanestFix: Re-derive the effect from corrected descriptives before making any practical-significance claim.

selfCritique.strongestObjection: A twelve-agent population is small, so the fragile-versus-stable split for borderline findings could shift under a larger or differently stratified population.
confidenceRaisers: A re-run at a larger population size to confirm the stability classification of REV-CTX-0001.
